flags: Integer Holdings Corporation entered into a Merger Agreement with affiliates of KKR (Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. L.P.) to be acquired for $127 per share in cash, with the transaction anticipated to close by the end of 2026.
Integer's stockholders approved the Merger Agreement at a special meeting on October 21, 2026, satisfying one of the closing conditions for the KKR take-private transaction.

Integer announced that its 2.125% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028 became convertible at the option of holders during the quarter ending December 31, 2026, because the stock price exceeded 130% of the conversion price for at least 20 of 30 trading days in the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

business_model.claim: Integer is a medical device contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) that sells components, subassemblies, and finished devices to large multinational OEMs in the Cardio and Vascular, Neuromodulation, and Cardiac Rhythm Management markets.
quotes: Integer Holdings Corporation, headquartered in Plano, Texas, is one of the world's largest medical device contract development and manufacturing organizations ("CDMOs"), serving the Cardio and Vascular, Neuromodulation, and Cardiac Rhythm Management markets.
Our primary customers include large, multi-national original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs") and their affiliated subsidiaries.

quotes: During 2025, three of our customers, Abbott Laboratories, Boston Scientific and Medtronic were each in excess of 10% of total sales and collectively accounted for 49% of our total sales.
In 2025, our top three customers collectively accounted for approximately 49% of our revenues.

material_events.claim: Integer announced that its 2.125% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028 became convertible at the option of holders during the quarter ending December 31, 2026, because the stock price exceeded 130% of the conversion price for at least 20 of 30 trading days in the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
quotes: On October 2, 2026, Integer Holdings Corporation (the "Company") announced that it had notified the holders of its 2.125% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028 (the "Notes") that the Notes have become convertible, at the option of the holders during the calendar quarter ending December 31, 2026.

The Notes became convertible because the last reported sale price of shares of the Company's common stock, for at least 20 trading days (whether or not consecutive) during the period of 30 consecutive trading days ending on, and including, the last trading day of the calendar quarter ended September 30, 2026, was greater than 130% of the conversion price in effect on each applicable trading day.

The Notes are convertible at a conversion rate of 11.4681 shares of common stock per $1,000 principal amount of Notes, which is equivalent to a conversion price of approximately $87.20 per share of common stock.

(the "Merger Agreement"), the Company is not providing a financial outlook and will not host a conference call to discuss its third quarter 2026 financial results.

risks.basis: stated in P1 (10-K Item 1 Business, customer concentration) and P2 (10-K Item 1A Risk Factors)

risks.basis: stated in P3 (10-K MD&A sales outlook) and P6 (8-K earnings release product line discussion)

The receipt of early termination of the waiting period under the HSR Act with respect to the consummation of the merger satisfies one of the conditions to the closing of the transactions contemplated by the Merger Agreement, which remains subject to other customary closing conditions, including approvals under certain other applicable antitrust and foreign direct investment laws.

The Lawsuits allege, among other claims, that the Proxy Statement omits and/or misleadingly describes material information about the Merger in violation of New York common law. The Lawsuits seek, among other remedies, an order enjoining the consummation of the Merger.
